newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures fall on improved arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures fall on improved arrivals.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery fell further by two rupees on Thursday to 1,140 rupees per quintal on improved arrivals, traders said.
Castorseed June delivery fell 7.5 rupees per quintal on Wednesday on higher supply and poor export enquiries.
In edible oils, groundnut oil rose by three rupees to 371 rupees per 10 kgs on limited arrivals. In Rajkot, it was steady at 570 rupees per 15 kg.
Imported palm oil traded at 292 rupees per 10 kg, one rupee above the previous closing.
"Market sentiment is generally firm," said a trader.
